# Plan: Async (background) debug logging thread for `collectdata`

## Goal

Give the `collectdata` C++ tool a background logging thread. Debug messages are
queued from the main thread and written to the console (and optionally a log
file) by one worker thread, so logging never blocks the caller.

**Chosen approach: Option A** — one joined worker thread with RAII shutdown
(no `.detach()`). This is the safer pattern.

```cpp
// AI generated by GitHub Copilot (DeepSeek V4 Pro), v1.0
/*
 * AsyncOutDebug.h
 *
 * Async (background-thread) debug message frontend and backend base.
 * The frontend implements the project's local Tools::Debug interface
 * (single std::string overload) and fans messages out to backends via
 * Tools::FastDelivery.
 */
#ifndef ASYNCOUTDEBUG_H_
#define ASYNCOUTDEBUG_H_

#include <list>
#include <string>
#include <mutex>
#include <semaphore>
#include <chrono>

#include "debug.h"          // local Tools::Debug + Tools::x_debug
#include "colored_output.h" // local ColoredOutput (terminal color detection)
#include <FastDelivery.h>   // Tools::FastDelivery::Publisher / PublisherNode

namespace AsyncOut {

struct Data
{
    const char                              *file;
    unsigned                                line;
    const char                              *function;
    std::string                             message;
    std::chrono::system_clock::time_point   when = std::chrono::system_clock::now();
};

class Logger : public Tools::FastDelivery::PublisherNode<Data>, public ColoredOutput
{
    std::list<value_type>       messages;
    std::mutex                  m_messages;
    std::counting_semaphore<>   m_worktodo{0};

public:
    void deliver( const value_type & msg );

    virtual void log();

    void wait();
    void wait_for( std::chrono::steady_clock::duration timeout );

protected:
    std::list<value_type> popAll();
};

class Debug : public Tools::Debug, public Tools::FastDelivery::Publisher<Data, Logger>
{
public:
    Debug();

    // implements the local Tools::Debug interface
    virtual void add( const char *file, unsigned line, const char *function, const std::string & s ) override;
};

} // namespace AsyncOut

#endif // ASYNCOUTDEBUG_H_
// End of AI generated by GitHub Copilot (DeepSeek V4 Pro), v1.0
```

```cpp
// AI generated by GitHub Copilot (DeepSeek V4 Pro), v1.0
#include "AsyncOutDebug.h"
#include <filesystem>
#include <iostream>

using namespace Tools;

AsyncOut::Debug::Debug()
: Tools::Debug()
{
}

void AsyncOut::Debug::add( const char *file, unsigned line, const char *function, const std::string & s )
{
    distribute( Data{file, line, function, s} );
}

void AsyncOut::Logger::deliver( const value_type & msg )
{
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> ml(m_messages);
    messages.push_back( msg );
    m_worktodo.release();
}

void AsyncOut::Logger::wait()
{
    m_worktodo.acquire();
}

void AsyncOut::Logger::wait_for( std::chrono::steady_clock::duration timeout )
{
    m_worktodo.try_acquire_for(timeout);
}

std::list<AsyncOut::Logger::value_type> AsyncOut::Logger::popAll()
{
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> ml(m_messages);
    std::list<value_type> ret( std::move_iterator(std::begin(messages)),
                               std::move_iterator(std::end(messages)) );
    messages.clear();
    return ret;
}

void AsyncOut::Logger::log()
{
    auto all_messages = popAll();

    for( const auto & m : all_messages ) {
        std::string file_name = std::filesystem::path(m.file).filename().string();
        std::cout << color_output( ColoredOutput::BRIGHT_YELLOW, file_name );
        std::cout << ':' << m.line << " " << m.message << '\n';
    }
}
// End of AI generated by GitHub Copilot (DeepSeek V4 Pro), v1.0
```

```cpp
// AI generated by GitHub Copilot (DeepSeek V4 Pro), v1.0
/*
 * AsyncFileLogger.h
 *
 * Async file backend: writes queued debug messages to a log file.
 * The file is size-capped; when a line would push it past max_size the
 * current file is rotated to <file>.1 and a fresh file is started.
 */
#ifndef ASYNCFILELOGGER_H_
#define ASYNCFILELOGGER_H_

#include "AsyncOutDebug.h"
#include <fstream>
#include <mutex>
#include <cstdint>

namespace AsyncOut {

inline constexpr std::uintmax_t kDefaultMaxLogSize = 10 * 1024 * 1024;  // 10 MB

class FileLogger : public AsyncOut::Logger
{
    std::string       m_filename;
    std::ofstream     m_file;
    std::mutex        m_file_mutex;
    std::uintmax_t    m_max_size;
    std::uintmax_t    m_written;

public:
    explicit FileLogger( const std::string & filename_,
                         std::uintmax_t max_size_ = kDefaultMaxLogSize );

    void log() override;

    void flush();

private:
    void rotate();
};

} // namespace AsyncOut

#endif // ASYNCFILELOGGER_H_
// End of AI generated by GitHub Copilot (DeepSeek V4 Pro), v1.0
```

```cpp
// AI generated by GitHub Copilot (DeepSeek V4 Pro), v1.0
#include "AsyncFileLogger.h"
#include <stderr_exception.h>
#include <format.h>
#include <filesystem>
#include <system_error>
#include <ctime>

using namespace AsyncOut;
using namespace Tools;

FileLogger::FileLogger( const std::string & filename_, std::uintmax_t max_size_ )
: m_filename(filename_),
  m_max_size(max_size_),
  m_written(0)
{
    m_file.open( m_filename, std::ios::out | std::ios::app );

    if( !m_file ) {
        throw STDERR_EXCEPTION( Tools::format( "cannot open log file '%s'", m_filename ) );
    }

    // Account for an existing file so the cap also holds across restarts.
    std::error_code ec;
    const auto size = std::filesystem::file_size( m_filename, ec );
    if( !ec ) {
        m_written = size;
    }
}

void FileLogger::rotate()
{
    m_file.close();

    std::error_code ec;
    std::filesystem::rename( m_filename, m_filename + ".1", ec );

    // Fallback for platforms where rename() does not replace an existing target.
    if( ec ) {
        std::filesystem::remove( m_filename + ".1", ec );
        std::filesystem::rename( m_filename, m_filename + ".1", ec );
    }

    m_file.open( m_filename, std::ios::out | std::ios::trunc );
    m_written = 0;
}

void FileLogger::log()
{
    auto lock = std::lock_guard(m_file_mutex);

    auto all_messages = popAll();

    for( const auto & m : all_messages ) {

        const std::time_t tt = std::chrono::system_clock::to_time_t( m.when );
        std::tm tm {};
        localtime_r( &tt, &tm );

        char timestamp[32];
        std::strftime( timestamp, sizeof(timestamp), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", &tm );

        std::string line;
        line += '[';
        line += timestamp;
        line += "] ";
        line += std::filesystem::path(m.file).filename().string();
        line += ':';
        line += std::to_string(m.line);
        line += ' ';
        line += m.message;
        line += '\n';

        // Rotate before writing if this line would push the file over the cap.
        if( m_max_size > 0 && m_written > 0 && m_written + line.size() > m_max_size ) {
            rotate();
        }

        m_file << line;
        m_written += line.size();
    }
}

void FileLogger::flush()
{
    auto lock = std::lock_guard(m_file_mutex);
    m_file.flush();
}
// End of AI generated by GitHub Copilot (DeepSeek V4 Pro), v1.0
```

```cpp
// AI generated by GitHub Copilot (DeepSeek V4 Pro), v1.0
/*
 * logging.h
 *
 * Lifecycle for the async debug logger: start it once, shut it down cleanly.
 */
#ifndef LOGGING_H_
#define LOGGING_H_

#include <string>

// Start the async debug logging session.
//   logFile : path of the log file; empty disables the file backend.
//   console : mirror every message to stdout (true when -d/--debug is given).
void logInit( const std::string & logFile, bool console );

// Stop the logger thread and free the backends. Safe to call even if
// logInit() was never called.
void logShutdown();

// RAII guard: shuts the logger down on scope exit, so the worker thread is
// always joined before the process exits.
class LogSession
{
public:
    LogSession() = default;
    ~LogSession() { logShutdown(); }

    LogSession( const LogSession & ) = delete;
    LogSession & operator=( const LogSession & ) = delete;
};

#endif // LOGGING_H_
// End of AI generated by GitHub Copilot (DeepSeek V4 Pro), v1.0
```

```cpp
// AI generated by GitHub Copilot (DeepSeek V4 Pro), v1.0
#include "logging.h"

#include "AsyncFileLogger.h"
#include "AsyncOutDebug.h"

#include <atomic>
#include <chrono>
#include <memory>
#include <thread>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <iostream>

namespace {

// How long the logger thread idles when nothing arrives.
constexpr std::chrono::milliseconds kIdleTimeout{200};

// The log file is flushed on a timer, not per line.
constexpr std::chrono::seconds kFlushInterval{3};

std::unique_ptr<AsyncOut::Debug>        g_frontend;
std::unique_ptr<AsyncOut::FileLogger>   g_file;
std::unique_ptr<AsyncOut::Logger>       g_console;
std::thread                             g_thread;
std::atomic<bool>                       g_quit{false};

// A backend must never be able to kill this thread; swallow its errors.
void drainConsole() {
    if (!g_console) return;
    try { g_console->log(); } catch (...) {}
}

void drainFile() {
    if (!g_file) return;
    try { g_file->log(); } catch (...) {}
}

void flushFile() {
    if (!g_file) return;
    try { g_file->flush(); } catch (...) {}
}

// The backend loop. A backend's semaphore is released by every message, so
// waiting on one of them is enough to know that something arrived.
void run() {
    pthread_setname_np(pthread_self(), "logger");

    AsyncOut::Logger* primary = g_file
        ? static_cast<AsyncOut::Logger*>(g_file.get())
        : g_console.get();

    auto next_flush = std::chrono::steady_clock::now() + kFlushInterval;

    while (!g_quit) {
        drainConsole();
        drainFile();

        if (std::chrono::steady_clock::now() > next_flush) {
            flushFile();
            next_flush = std::chrono::steady_clock::now() + kFlushInterval;
        }

        if (primary) {
            primary->wait_for(kIdleTimeout);
        } else {
            std::this_thread::sleep_for(kIdleTimeout);
        }
    }

    // Final drain while the backends are still alive.
    drainConsole();
    drainFile();
}

} // namespace

void logInit( const std::string & logFile, bool console )
{
    if (!logFile.empty()) {
        // Backends before the frontend: a log file that cannot be opened must
        // not leave Tools::x_debug installed pointing at a half-built object.
        try {
            g_file = std::make_unique<AsyncOut::FileLogger>(logFile);
        } catch (const std::exception&) {
            g_file.reset();
        }
    }

    if (console) {
        g_console = std::make_unique<AsyncOut::Logger>();
    }

    if (!g_file && !g_console) {
        return;  // nowhere to deliver to; DEBUG stays a no-op
    }

    g_frontend = std::make_unique<AsyncOut::Debug>();

    if (g_file)    g_frontend->subscribe(g_file.get());
    if (g_console) g_frontend->subscribe(g_console.get());

    // From here on DEBUG has somewhere to go.
    Tools::x_debug = g_frontend.get();

    g_quit = false;
    g_thread = std::thread(run);
}

void logShutdown()
{
    g_quit = true;

    if (g_thread.joinable()) {
        g_thread.join();
    }

    // Stop any further DEBUG before the subscriber list is dismantled.
    Tools::x_debug = nullptr;

    // Backends first: destroying a backend unsubscribes it and closes the
    // log file. The frontend must outlive its backends.
    g_file.reset();
    g_console.reset();
    g_frontend.reset();
}
// End of AI generated by GitHub Copilot (DeepSeek V4 Pro), v1.0
```
